args.action_description: FRAME FORMAT: identical even canvas, constant physical pivot, fixed whole-body scale and exact source palette. Preserve original character, helmet, armor, body height and rigid weapon dimensions in every frame. Keep the existing LOW TOP-DOWN view and existing direction. North aims up away from viewer, south down, east right, west left. Never switch to front pseudo3D or a different camera. Full body visible with transparent margins. Brace the existing shoulder rocket launcher, aim forward in the current facing, fire ONE rocket with a brief orange muzzle flash and small shoulder recoil, then lower the tube slightly and return to ready. No barrel stretching or new weapons. Do not draw a rocket flying far away; projectile leaves muzzle.
